start: AI Assistant open on the Ask tab, no chat yet

steps.action: Open AI Assistant from the menu
user_sees: Title 'AI Assistant'
Tabs 'Ask' and 'History'
Heading 'Try saying' with up to four sentences in quote marks
Link 'See all {n} things it can do'
Line 'Asking is free. A task uses credits only when you send or save it.'
must_not: A diet plan example in the list
A dated festival sentence under Try saying

user_sees: The sentence is in the ask box, ready to change
The cursor is in the box
must_not: The sentence asked at once without a tap on send

steps.action: Change a word and tap the send button
user_sees: The sentence shows as a bubble
'Thinking…'
Then a card with the answer
must_not: The untouched example sent instead of the changed words

start: AI Assistant open on the Ask tab, no chat yet

steps.action: Tap 'See all {n} things it can do'
user_sees: Sheet titled 'What the AI Assistant can do'
Line 'Tap one to put it in the box. Change it, then ask.'
Groups 'Messages to members', 'Members and plans', 'Money', 'Questions about the gym', 'Help with settings'
must_not: An empty group heading with no sentences under it
A number in the link that differs from the count of sentences in the sheet

steps.action: Tap one sentence in the sheet
user_sees: The sheet closes
The sentence is in the ask box
must_not: The sheet left open over the box

start: Today's free questions are used up (the box says 'No more free questions today. Ask again tomorrow.')

user_sees: The sentence is set in the locked box, which stays greyed out
The send button stays off
must_not: The sentence sent past the daily limit
A box that looks ready to type in while it is locked

user_sees: Nothing is asked
must_not: An error pop-up with code words

start: A chat with one answer is on screen (the Try saying list is hidden)

user_sees: The chat is cleared
'Try saying' and the examples link are back
must_not: Old cards left under the examples
A saved task or credit undone by clearing the chat

steps.action: Tap a sentence, then switch to 'History' and back to 'Ask'
user_sees: The sentence is still in the box
must_not: The typed sentence lost on a tab change
